## Summary

One or two sentences describing the change.

## Related Issue

Fixes # (issue number)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Tooling or CI

## Screenshots or Recordings

If the change affects the game visually, include a screenshot or a short
recording.

## Checklist

- [ ] The project opens in the Unity Editor without console errors.
- [ ] All existing scenes still load.
- [ ] New scripts include the standard file header.
- [ ] Documentation under `docs/` is updated if behaviour changed.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated if this is user-visible.
